description.description: A side-by-side composite of three booking mugshots of young men. The individual on the left has curly dark hair and a beard, wearing a black shirt. The individual in the middle is bald with a dense dark beard, wearing an orange jail jumpsuit over a white t-shirt. The individual on the right has short dark hair and a thin mustache and goatee, wearing a white t-shirt. All three are positioned against a plain grey background.
